verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own docs show some bulk-style capabilities: spreadsheet import of cap table data and a support article on adding multiple companies via a template. These are bulk creation or import paths only. There is no evidence of bulk actions such as mass edits, bulk issuance, or batch signing across many existing items. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update or action operations across many existing records, any detail on scope or limits of the template and import features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
